answer: Require each identity to anchor to a fresh manufacturer-signed hardware attestation: a secure-enclave key that has never registered before. A farm cannot mint new enclaves in software, so every extra identity costs one more physical device plus its signed attestation, and costs rise like a gale instead of a flat fee. Self-written histories are worthless; only an ivory-stamped factory certificate counts, and any fable about reusing one chip across ten agents fails the uniqueness check at registration.
